start.text: The last bell rang ten minutes ago. The classroom is empty — except for the girl by the window.

intro-1.speaker: Hana
intro-1.text: There you are! I was starting to think you'd forgotten.

the-question.prompt: Hana tilts her head, waiting for your answer.

accept-1.speaker: Hana
accept-1.text: Really? Oh, this is going to be fun. I already know exactly which shelf to show you first.

hesitate-1.speaker: Hana
hesitate-1.text: Oh. That's all right. Not everyone falls in love with books right away.

paper-1.text: Instead of arguing, she slips a folded sheet of paper from her notebook.

paper-2.speaker: Hana
paper-2.text: A poem. A short one. Read it before you decide.

poem-1.text:
Rain writes in silver
on the window of my heart.

clubroom-1.speaker: Hana
clubroom-1.text: Here we are. Welcome to the literature club.

ending.title: The First Page
ending.text: Some stories begin with a book. Others begin with the person who hands you one.
